project_summary: A consumer mobile app for habit tracking targeting 18-30 year olds, freemium model with $4.99/mo Pro tier.

failure_risks.risk: Habit-tracking app market is saturated with free incumbents (Streaks, Habitica, Loop), which compresses willingness to pay for the Pro tier and depresses LTV below CAC at any reasonable acquisition cost.

action_map.validation_step: Test paid conversion against the free incumbents.
action_map.minimum_test: Run a 30-day paid acquisition test with $5,000 spend.
action_map.success_metric: Free-to-paid conversion above 3% and CAC under $15.

failure_risks.risk: The Pro feature set is undefined and not validated against actual willingness to pay; without a clear paid feature, freemium users will not convert and the unit economics collapse before retention compounds.

action_map.validation_step: Validate PMF on the Pro feature set.
action_map.minimum_test: Run a Wizard of Oz test of 3 candidate Pro features over 2 weeks.
action_map.success_metric: 30% of beta users select at least one Pro feature as must-have.
action_map.failure_threshold: Below 10% must-have selection on all candidates.
action_map.next_action: If pass: build the winning feature. If fail: rethink the Pro tier entirely.

failure_risks.risk: Retention on habit-tracking apps drops 80% by week 4 across the category; without an intervention specifically designed to combat this, the freemium funnel will not produce enough paid users to sustain growth.

action_map.validation_step: Test the retention mechanic against category benchmarks.
action_map.minimum_test: Cohort analysis on 500 beta users over 4 weeks with the new mechanic.
